11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL depth-shading is genuinely sophisticated, and the zoom interaction with breadcrumb navigation and smooth transitions is polished — held back from 8 by the leaf labels being too small to read at the root level and the random lightness jitter on leaf cells adding visual noise.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap area encoding is mathematically correct (d3.treemap proportionally maps summed file sizes to area), color is categorical-only, zoom uses honest domain-swap on data-derived bounds; key function uses fragile string concatenation but causes no honesty issue for this static, non-updating visualization.
11-zoomable-treemap.stress_test_note: Mutable x/y scale domains are closed over in the t.on('end') updateVisibility callback — safe here only because .interrupt() prevents stale end-callbacks from firing, but the pattern is fragile; no update-storm, loop, or touch-fight issues since zoom is click-based and pointer events are used throughout.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with 8 Tol-palette colors (at the warning threshold but perceptually discriminable), HCL lightness progression creates clear depth hierarchy, label-hiding for small cells and progressive zoom disclosure manage density well — root-level leaf labels are unreadable but the interaction model is designed for that.
